summary: Forfeiture of earnest money in real estate agreements; contractual clauses vs. RERA provisions; unreasonableness of 20% forfeiture; standard of unconscionability in consumer disputes; precedent-based review of NCDRC decision; market condition as grounds for cancellation.
legal_provisions_cited: Haryana Real Estate Regulatory Authority Gurugram Regulations, 2018
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; NCDRC judgment set aside; forfeiture of 20% of Basic Sale Price upheld; refund of balance amount after deduction confirmed.
